svg.title: Known-best packing of 305 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=305 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: The retained source gives a finite rational certificate of 305 unit squares at its exact side. The claim is feasibility at that side. The source's comments on area, optimization and earlier arrangements are separate claims.

svg.text: U n=305 known best: side ~ 17.94575584 (certified upper bound)
